project: THE STOCK MARKET: FROM THE GROUND UP
definition: Every engine/edition has eight new additive acceptance features. integrated counts only completed member-source integration; partial and staff-only prototypes do not count. Not a release, labor or overall completion percent.

features.title: First-principles lesson instruction
features.acceptance_criterion: Authorized member sees correct teaching for selected canonical topic.
features.unresolved: Individual accuracy and genuine session review open.

features.title: Worked EMA and risk calculations
features.acceptance_criterion: Verify units, seeds, arithmetic and changed independent example in member Lab.
features.unresolved: Exact browser and editor acceptance open.

features.title: Evidence-led misconception feedback
features.acceptance_criterion: Observed mistakes yield supported ungraded feedback without made-up mastery.
features.unresolved: Real learner and independent editorial acceptance open.

features.title: Prerequisite review from existing evidence
features.acceptance_criterion: Show only authorized prerequisite suggestions without changing stored competency.

features.title: Independent practice, retries and transfer
features.acceptance_criterion: Distinct ungraded transfer must not disclose answers before an attempt.
features.unresolved: Protected grade and accessibility acceptance open.

features.title: Complete indicator-topic teaching parity
features.acceptance_criterion: All released EMA, RSI, MACD, ATR and Bollinger lessons have approved mappings.
features.unresolved: Some calculations exist without approved lesson mapping.

features.title: Free Foundations and Academy progression parity
features.acceptance_criterion: Genuine learners maintain prerequisite and stage progress across courses.

features.title: Individually reviewed and accessible whole-catalogue instruction

features.title: Ungraded retries and independent transfer

features.title: 419 original individually authored Lab cases
